This is exactly the same page, same seoId (1170), and same exclusion reasoning already documented on the sibling GB storefront (S.N. 90) under its English label 'Special Prices'. No separate Outlet/Clearance/Final-Sale/Last-Chance/End-of-Line URL exists anywhere in nav, sitemap, or robots.txt. Concluding no genuine Clearance PLP exists on Zara Home DE.
